concept: Integrity when no one is watching — doing the right thing with no audience
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Singapore CCE-style staged progression principles — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is given a realistic scenario (e.g. finding an answer key, an unattended item) with no visible consequences either way
exercise.branching_choice: Student picks a response; the scenario shows a believable downstream effect of that choice
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up dialogue on why the choice was made

assessment.success_marker: student's reasoning holds up under one round of gentle pushback from the mentor persona
